newsitem.title: UK: Pakistan minister sees quick banking reforms.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan minister sees quick banking reforms.

text.p: Pakistan wants to focus on banking reform to help get the economy on track, acting Commerce Minister Mohammad Zubair Khan said on Thursday.
The government is looking a a range of reforms including a review of tariffs and public spending as well as administrative reforms.
"We believe some quick steps can be taken in all these areas particularly the banking sector... (which) has come under a fairly sharp critisism recently," he told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV).
"We would like to make sure that the basic foundation of our economy is made healthy in a very short time," he added.
He had earlier said that Pakistan planned to introduce tariff reforms from the next fiscal 1997/98 (July-June) at a slow pace to protect domestic industry and without disturbing revenue collection.
